shared_elements: elaborately curled/beaded hair and beard rendered as rows of tight curls
low relief carving of processional figures
patterned garment/textile detail rendered by incised repeating motifs
justification: Both show bearded/curly-haired human figures in strict profile low relief, with hair and beard rendered as identical rows of stacked ringlets and drapery marked by fine incised repeating patterns — a highly conventional and specific shared manner of depiction. However, the depicted scenes differ: A is a close-up of one or two large frontal-torso figures with raised arm and no animals or setting, whereas B is a horizontal procession of small attendants leading horned rams past a conical tree above a rosette border.
